subject: general
question: Which of the following is a symptom of Beriberi?

options.text: Poor skin health and swollen belly

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2) Weak muscles and low-energy**__

Beriberi is a condition caused by a deficiency of vitamin B1 (thiamine), and it can lead to symptoms such as weakness, muscle atrophy, and fatigue due to the effect of thiamine deficiency on the nervous system and muscle function.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are two main types of beriberi: **Wet beriberi**, and **Dry beriberi.**
 
• **Wet beriberi** is characterized by edema and heart-related symptoms, 
 
• ** Dry beriberi** primarily involves nervous system issues.
 
• Early diagnosis and thiamine supplementation are crucial for the successful treatment of beriberi. 
 
• Supplementation with thiamine and dietary improvements are common approaches to managing the condition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__** Common symptoms of beriberi include:**__

 
 

 **Muscle Weakness**
 Weakness and fatigue, particularly in the legs and extremities.
 
 

 **Peripheral Neuropathy**
 Numbness, tingling, and loss of sensation in the hands and feet.
 
 

 **Edema**
 Swelling of the lower legs, ankles, and feet due to fluid retention.
 
 

 **Cardiac Symptoms**
 In some cases, beriberi can lead to heart problems, including an enlarged heart, which may cause heart failure.
 
 

 **Difficulty Walking**
 Impaired coordination and difficulty walking due to muscle weakness and nerve damage.
 
 

 **Confusion and Cognitive Impairment**
 Cognitive changes, including confusion, memory problems, and difficulty concentrating.
 
 

 **Anorexia**
 Loss of appetite and weight loss.
 
 

 **Wernicke-Korsakoff Syndrome**
 In severe cases, beriberi can lead to a neurological disorder characterized by confusion, amnesia, and eye movement abnormalities.
